propositions: The writing guide omits all 15 registered coaching move names despite authors receiving coached feedback referencing those moves.

Top five coaching moves by field frequency are specification-by-example (150), plan-the-verification (96), riskiest-assumption-test (51), state-attestation-evidence (41), and propagate-to-children (22), with observable-proxy rule and [operator-attested] tag absent from guide documentation.
A 'Responding to coaching moves' section with technique descriptions and before/after examples for the top five moves plus a one-line index of remaining moves should be added to the guide.
The [operator-attested] AC tag must be documented in the state-attestation-evidence move entry.
Move names in guide documentation must match MOVE_REGISTRY spellings exactly, verified by unit tests importing coach_moves.py.
